attrs.doc: Total sums the values, accumulating in place.
Mix folds the values together with the operators a hash uses.
MaxRetries bounds the retry loop.
DefaultName is the fallback identity for an unnamed record.
Enabled reports whether the fixture feature is on by default.
Threshold is the default cutoff.
ID is an alias for the underlying identity spelling.
Celsius is a temperature in degrees Celsius.
Add returns the sum of a and b.
Scale multiplies value by factor.
unexported returns n unchanged.
Runner is anything that can run.
Run performs one unit of work and reports the running count.
Describer is anything that can describe itself.
Describe renders a description.
Job is anything that runs and describes itself.
Engine counts the work it has done.
calls is how many times Run has been called.
Run performs one unit of work and reports the running count.
Driver runs work through an engine and describes what it is doing.
Engine performs the work this driver drives.
label describes this driver.
Describe renders a description.
Run performs one unit of work and reports the running count.
NewDriver returns a driver labelled for display, driving the given engine.
ErrEmpty is returned when the input string has no content.
Length reports the length of s, failing on the empty string.
Check reports whether s is usable, returning only a failure.
Twice returns the length of s doubled.
Validate checks s and reports nothing else.
Report records a failure alongside what was being attempted.
action names what was attempted.
cause is why it did not succeed.
Measure reports the length of s, failing on the empty string.
Origin names the point type rectangles are built from.
Bounds is a rectangle described by its two opposite corners.
Min is the lower corner.
Max is the upper corner.
Size reports how many labelled counts the table holds.
Prefix is the identity prefix every generated name starts with.
Limit is the ceiling this component will not exceed. Zero means unbounded.
Describe returns the name of this component.
Counter counts.

Bump adds one through the pointer, so the parameter is an exclusive borrow and the argument
lends exclusively.
Read returns the count without writing, so the parameter is a shared borrow.
Twice bumps the counter twice, handing the same local to a borrowing parameter each time.
Half returns n halved, and aborts on an odd input.
Label is a display name derived from a prefix.
prefix is the source the display name is derived from.
text is the current display name.
Name returns the display name.
Refresh recomputes the display name from the prefix.
NewLabel returns a label whose display name is derived from prefix.
Tag is a display name that never changes.
text is the fixed display name.
Name returns the display name.
Refresh recomputes the display name, which for a fixed tag is already current.
NewTag returns a tag with the given fixed display name.
Describe returns the display name of anything that can name itself.
Counter accumulates a total.
total is the running sum.
label names the counter.
Add adds n to the counter.
Label reports the counter's name.
Merge folds other into this counter.
Total reports the accumulated value.
NewCounter returns a counter starting at zero, named for display.
Tally is a counter allocated away from the caller's frame.
label names the tally.
NewTally returns a tally named for display.
Width reports the width of s once it clears the minimum, and zero otherwise.
Span reports the width of s, counting a short string as one wider than it is.
Scaled reports n scaled by the fixed factor this function works in.
Buffer returns a zeroed buffer of the fixed width the protocol uses.
Seeds returns the fixed seed table.
Widths returns the configured widths.
Empty returns no widths at all.
Swap exchanges the values at i and j.
Point is a location in two dimensions.
X is the horizontal coordinate.
Y is the vertical coordinate.
label names the point for display.
Area reports the area of the rectangle between the origin and this point.
Label returns the point's display name.
Shift returns the point moved by the given deltas, keeping its label.
NewPoint returns the point at the given coordinates, labelled for display.
Named is anything that can render its own display name.
Name returns the display name.
Refresh recomputes the display name from the current state.
Origin is the point at the coordinate origin.
